name: English Studio Hub by Ms. Maria
description: An interactive English grammar learning studio designed for students, featuring 12 comprehensive modules (Nouns through Punctuation & Mechanics) with diagnostic evaluations, a 100-question grand assessment, non-repetitive daily practice with easy/medium/hard difficulties, calming background study soundscapes, a dedicated two-way Student & Teacher Chat channel with speech synthesis, and a secure password-protected teacher portal for Ms. Maria.
